description: New community of spacious townhomes with two-car garages in Waxhaw, NC. description: Master-planned community of single-family homes in the peaceful suburbia of Garner, zoned for the highly rated Cleveland School District. Residents enjoy a private clubhouse with a swimming pool and fitness center, plus a playground and athletic field. Close to Swift Creek Shopping Plaza and White Oak Crossing, with nearby Langdon Pond, Hinnant Farms Vineyard & Winery, and Lake Benson Park for fishing, hiking, and paddle boating.

Master-planned community of new ranch-style homes, townhomes, and two-story single-family homes in Kannapolis, part of Kannapolis City Schools. Onsite amenities include a swimming pool, playground/tot lot, and picnic area. Just over a mile from downtown Kannapolis for shopping, dining, and entertainment, near Bakers Creek Park and Village Park, with the Charlotte metro area a short drive away.

Community of new single-family homes with onsite amenities in Lillington, including a saltwater pool with cabana area, playground, and scenic pond. Residents are close to local eateries and boutique shopping in downtown Lillington and Angier, with convenient access to NC-55, US-401, and I-40, plus nearby hospitals and universities. Within a 20-minute drive of Raven Rock State Park, Lillington River Park, and Cape Fear River Adventures.
